literal_meaning: যতক্ষণ মধু থাকে ততক্ষণ ভ্রমর থাকে
figurative_meaning_en: Selfish or opportunistic friendship that lasts only while there is personal gain
similar_in_english: A friend in need is a friend indeed (contrasting)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে যতক্ষণ মধু ততক্ষণ ভ্রমরের মতো আমার সঙ্গে বন্ধুত্ব করে।
ব্যবসায়িক লাভ থাকলে তবেই তারা বন্ধু, যতক্ষণ মধু ততক্ষণ ভ্রমর।
example_sentences_in_english: He sticks around like a bee to honey only as long as there's benefit—truly a fair-weather friend.
Their partnership is just opportunistic; as long as there's honey, the bees will buzz around.
note: This idiom draws from natural observation of bees and honey, common in rural Bengali folklore.
